findings.claim: The Surreal projection adapter no longer compiles because `apply` returns `Ok(false)` from a function whose success type is `ProjectionApply`.
findings.evidence: In `SurrealEntityProjection::apply`, the hunk shows `) -> Result<ProjectionApply, PortError>` and then `if !cursor_advances(checkpoint, &cursor)? { return Ok(false); }`, while `ProjectionApply` is an enum re-exported from `frf_ports` and other implementations return `ProjectionApply::Duplicate` for this case.
findings.suggested_fix: Return `Ok(ProjectionApply::Duplicate)` when the cursor does not advance.
